thread:
jamie: pushed fixes for the flaky integration test — split the big scenario, removed the DB sleep and tightened assertions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/832

alex: looks better. CI still failing on lint though — can you rebase onto main and squash the linter commit?

jamie: done the rebase + fixed the lint (removed unused import). kicked off CI. @deploy-bot can you trigger a rerun of the integration job if it flakes?

deploy-bot: rebuild requested by @jamie — job 5621 queued, runner-3.ETA ~6m. I will post status.

priyanka: quick skim — small nit in retry_helper: prefer explicit timeout instead of relying on default. left an inline comment. Other than that looks good.

jamie: thanks, added timeout=30s and a short comment explaining rationale. pushed new commit. please recheck when you get a sec.

lance: :eyes: skimming now. test addition is tiny and helpful. one optional suggestion: add an edge-case for empty payloads? not blocking.

jamie: added a minimal unit for empty payloads too, pushed. unit tests passing locally.

alex: I can give LGTM once integrations are green. also, when do you want to merge? we have a quiet window from 2–4pm PT for canaries.

jamie: aiming to merge before EOD PT if integrations pass. if CI is green by 1:30pm I can queue the canary during the 2pm window. otherwise will wait for the next quiet slot.

priyanka: integrations just went green on job 5621 — all checks passed.

alex: giving approval. please add a short release note line for the changelog and feel free to merge during the 2pm canary window. :+1:

jamie: added changelog line and will merge at 2pm. thanks all! :tada:
